title: Emerald Canine Guardian
description: A vibrant green canine-like creature with orange eyes and scaled armor stands in profile, looking right. A smaller snarling green wolf head emerges from its chest armor while glowing green ethereal ribbons and vines swirl around its body and head, some ending in small flames or flowers.
prompt: A majestic green canine creature with detailed scales and armor stands in three-quarter view looking to the right, orange eyes glowing. A smaller fierce green wolf head protrudes from its chest plate. Swirling glowing emerald ribbons, vines and magical energy with small flowers and flames wrap dynamically around its body and head against a dark purple background with dramatic green light rays from above.
